rival_reading: An ordinary service visit or experimental survey could leave a late key record; the mismatch alone does not show officials mishandled a wider warning.
gloss: A key return is recorded after a route acknowledgment time.
title: Acknowledgment follows the route closure
body: The key was returned after the route's acknowledgment time had passed. A child's sun is drawn on the tag; the only completed line records the key, not who received the warning.

rival_reading: A weather note may be ordinary planning and a revised bulletin may follow an emergency order; the dates do not establish a program malfunction.
gloss: A dated field note predates a bulletin revision beside ordinary work items.
title: Bulletin amended after field note
body: The notebook's weather entry is dated before the route bulletin changed. Someone marked the sun column for a child's school walk; the tally records returned bottles, not who heard the update.
